title: Actual finite-Q3 onsite-plus-all-bond split-step commutator recurrence audit
question: Does one exact onsite-plus-all-bond finite Q3 Lie-Trotter step satisfy the registered four-context local q/p commutator recurrence, without silently replacing the split product by the unsplit Hamiltonian flow?

finite_fixture.graph: target edge, square face, and 2x3 rectangular grid

model.split_step: U_delta=product of exact exp(-i delta h_term/hbar) factors, with all onsite terms and all lexicographic bond terms; both declared term orders are tested
model.observable: A_a=exp(i a(q_0+q_1)/hbar), with A and A* contexts
model.contexts: U_{sigma,delta}^n A^{epsilon} U_{sigma,delta}^{*n} for sigma in {-1,+1}, epsilon in {1,*}, and both term orders
model.scope: finite exact matrix split-product applicability test; not the final common-core seminorm

lean_crosscheck.role: R326 checks exact rational step, time, order, support and scope fixtures only; Python checks the finite matrix split products.

next_action: If either declared product order violates the recurrence, retain the failure as a split-step route boundary and attack a state-weighted or non-Leibniz topology. If both pass, vary source, beta and volume before any common-alpha promotion.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite actual-Q3 split-step audit. It does not prove or refute every Q3 common-core topology, a thermodynamic dynamics, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.
no_overclaim: Finite split-product violations are route-local evidence only; no asymptotic divergence, split-dynamics no-go, or QFT conclusion is inferred.
